violations.description: Entire integration/unit/regression test suite (38 files) imports the pre-restructure module layout (fedcrg.domain, fedcrg.configuration, fedcrg.decision, fedcrg.evaluation, fedcrg.datasets, fedcrg.artifacts, fedcrg.federation, fedcrg.scoring, fedcrg.reporting.*, fedcrg.runtime.*, fedcrg.experiments.*) that no longer exists; collection fails

pyproject entry point fedcrg.cli.app:cli is broken; cli.py is a module not a package. CLI surface exposes internal stages (data prepare, tables precompute-readiness, sensitivity run, robustness deep-svdd, synthetic run, benchmark, environment freeze) instead of the target validate/preprocess/plan/run/campaign/status/monitor/report/results surface

cli.py lazy-loads modules that do not exist (fedcrg.experiments.definitions.sensitivity, model_training, computational_benchmark, dataset_preparation) and calls RunAllExperiments.execute with a signature the runner does not have (model_seed/calibration_seed kwargs)
DependencyResolver implements a hand-rolled topological sort instead of graphlib.TopologicalSorter (goal section 21)

ORACLE_TEST policy is not materialized: PolicyThresholdSet.for_client raises for oracle_test, EvaluatePolicies builds `final` evidence but never uses oracle_choice; a config containing oracle_test crashes evaluation

build_run_id interpolates the DetectorConfig model object into the run id instead of detector.id.value; unused detector_label variable; RunManifestStore.save does not enforce immutability of completed runs

Prepared-cache reuse (_reuse_existing) validates only data_spec_hash and dataset id; it does not verify manifest/source hashes, role file existence, or role file hashes, and does not include source-file identity in the cache identity (goal 14, 32)

split_base attack-development allocation samples uniformly from the remaining pool instead of the locked rules: N-BaIoT floor(500/m)+lexicographic remainder per subtype (roadmap 7.1.3), DIAD capacity-aware water-filling (roadmap 7.2.3)
PreparedDatasetManifest.external_replication_supported is inverted (True for N-BaIoT, False for DIAD); PreprocessingModel lacks the roadmap-required constant_features diagnostic

build_publication signature (outputs, config) does not match CLI call (config, outputs_root, prepared_manifest, destination); duplicate RunManifest import; results builder copies metric records from non-completed runs
Roadmap 8.3/14.5.1 deterministic communication ledgers (model/preprocessing/policy payload accounting) have no implementation; old tests for them were deleted with the old layout

tools/audit_repository.py enforces the OLD architecture (requires configuration/, datasets/, decision/ packages); Makefile and README reference fedcrg.cli.app and configs/ paths; noxfile audit session runs the stale tool
ruff select is minimal (E,F,UP,B) vs goal of comprehensive rules; pyright standard vs strict; 50 ruff errors and 22 unformatted files currently
Missing contract tests: preprocessing reuse 10 scenarios (goal 32), cache reuse invalidation (goal 33), publication bundle tests (goal 34), runtime/console observability tests (goal 35)
